description: This file defines the WorkerExecutor class for managing web workers, including task queueing, worker creation, message handling, and event management.

classes.name: WorkerExecutor
classes.description: A class to manage a pool of web workers, handle task execution, and manage worker lifecycle.

methods.name: _getWorker
methods.description: Retrieves an available worker from the pool or creates a new one.

methods.name: _createWorker
methods.description: Creates a new web worker instance.

methods.name: _handleTaskEnd
methods.description: Handles cleanup and recycling of a worker after task completion.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Queues a task to be executed by a worker, with timeout and event handling.
